name: Sulaiman-Too Sacred Mountain
description: Rising straight out of the city of Osh in Kyrgyzstan's Fergana Valley, Sulaiman-Too is a five-peaked rock that travellers on the Silk Roads treated as a landmark and holy place for over 1,500 years. Footpaths link its 17 active shrines, caves with 101 catalogued petroglyph sites, and two rebuilt 16th-century mosques. Pilgrims still climb it hoping for healing and long life.
